counting_model: These are conservative logical WPVibe action counts for planning, not a claim about account billing or quota accounting. A future live counter read is authoritative. Opera/GitHub checks do not consume this planned WPVibe budget.

phase_0_remote_gate.purpose: establish usable +5 remote window and accepted live owners before any mutation
minimum_actions: ID35 status/owner read if not bundled: 1
phase_0_remote_gate.go_rule: Do not start any write package unless the whole package plus immediate readback plus at least 10 recovery calls fits above the live remaining counter.

minimum_actions_after_phase0: guarded search/exact unique insertion owner if not already bundled in phase0: 0-1

operations.review_anchor_optional: raw owner search 1 + edit 1 + readback 1 = about 3 only if owner is proven safe

phase_2_structural_v014.planned_range: 6 without optional review ID; 9 with review ID
phase_2_structural_v014.rule: Each operation is its own stop point. A failure/drift in one prevents blindly continuing to the next.

phase_3_stress_semantics_visual.note: Can be split into semantic 3-call unit and visual 4-call unit if quota is tighter.

minimum_actions: one or two guarded match-once edits depending exact returned snippet: 1-2
table-title CSS marked write/readback if not folded into a separately approved CSS package: 2-3
phase_4_table_source_structure.rule: Do not move caption/title by reconstructing the full widget.

minimum_actions: scoped CSS owner/marker read + write + readback: 3
phase_5_expectations_v003.rule: This is the highest-risk legacy regrouping and must never be started near reserve. Prefer one complete fresh window.

minimum_actions: one coherent marked CSS write for all approved CTA/FAQ companion blocks: 1
phase_6_FAQ_CTA_v004.planned_range: 7-8 after FAQ-order predecessor is already complete
phase_6_FAQ_CTA_v004.rule: If FAQ-order predecessor is not complete, add its ~3-call unit first.

phase_7_reviews.owner_diagnostic_only: Additional CSS exact owner searches can often be combined into 1-2 reads
phase_7_reviews.quote_v002: if owner proof allows, one CSS write + readback about 2
phase_7_reviews.ordinal_and_active_dot: after owner proof, ideally one tiny CSS write + readback about 2
phase_7_reviews.review_anchor: about 3 if not already done in v014
phase_7_reviews.third_author_role_text: fresh search + edit + readback about 3 only if shorter live text is reconfirmed
phase_7_reviews.decor: pseudo-owner read + marked CSS write + readback about 3, optional/last

minimum_wp_actions: final ID35 status if not bundled: 0-1
closeout.browser_QA: Use source/target pair only when page256 browser ownership is available; does not spend planned WPVibe calls.

recommended_window_strategy: Never measure a package against a stale counter. Read the exact live counter first.
If remaining-above-reserve is <8, do no new remote mutation; do GitHub/static/browser work only.
If 8-15 calls are available above reserve, choose one low-risk complete phase such as CSS v006 or one structural microfix plus readback; do not start expectations.
If 16-25 are available above reserve, a medium complete structure+visual phase can run with margin.
Expectations v003 should start only with substantially more than its 11-14 planned calls plus the 10-call reserve, because multiple exact searches/readbacks may be required.
Any 429/unknown write immediately consumes the rest of the planned package until exact readback resolves state; do not budget a retry.
